tuned_hyperparameters.selection_rationale: Alpha = 0.60 achieved the minimum 5-fold cross-validation RMSE (0.3921), near-zero mean bias error (-0.0356), higher macro F1 (50.63% vs 47.96%), and higher exact agreement (80.0% vs 76.7%) compared to the 0.50 baseline, while avoiding the negative underprediction drift observed at alpha >= 0.70.

section_weights.modification_decision: Retained existing candidate constrained weights without modification. Cross-validation demonstrated that fitting 8 independent weights on N=30 observations creates severe parameter estimation variance and risks overfitting. Preserving the structurally robust candidate weights ensures monotonic bounded similarity in [0.0, 4.0] and stability across all 600 reference projects.

scientific_safeguards.held_out_status: Strictly held-out; zero parameters or weights were fitted or tuned using held-out annotations.
